verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a Marketing Emails API to programmatically create and update emails, and custom coded templates in the design manager for programmable emails. A local development CLI exists, but the evidence only shows a version check, not a template sync or version-control workflow. Variable substitution syntax is not evidenced. missing for 10: documented variable/personalization substitution in templates, evidence of a CLI or git-based workflow keeping templates under version control, HTML/MJML template-as-code detail, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control

citations.quote: You can use the Marketing Emails API to programmatically create, update, and get details about marketing emails.
In the design manager, you can create custom modules and custom coded templates that can be used for programmable emails.
You can check which version of the CLI you have installed by running `hs --version`.
